label: prf:categorical-laplace-unique
title: Proof of uniqueness of the categorical Laplace transform
html: Two monoidal functors \mathcal{L}, \mathcal{L}' with the same intertwining property are determined by their values on the generator \exp_q(-s\cdot) (uniqueness of \exp_q): fixing \mathcal{L}[\exp_q(-s\cdot)] pins down the functor on all of \mathcal{H}_q by monoidality. The Frobenius-pairing mate of \Delta_q is unique up to isomorphism, hence \mathcal{L} \cong \mathcal{L}'.
heading: Proof
